audience: event organizers who run events and guest lists on Luma

useCases.title: Check upcoming events and their guest counts
useCases.text: List the upcoming events of the calendar. Then list the guests of one event to count the approved and waitlisted ones.

useCases.title: Review event submissions waiting for approval
useCases.text: List the submissions that are pending approval. Open one event to read its details and its ticket types.

useCases.title: Approve or decline a guest registration
useCases.text: Find the guest on the event list and read the registration. Then set the guest status. No email is sent unless you ask for one.

useCases.title: Review email blasts and coupons for an event
useCases.text: List the email blasts sent to the guests of one event and read one blast. List the coupons that apply to the event.

useCases.title: Look up an event from its Luma link
useCases.text: Paste a lu.ma or luma.com link to find the event. Then read its full details.
